11th Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Warding Network

While you don’t possess the inherent sealing chains granted by your bloodline, you instead have the inherent ability to increase your resilience to Fuinjutsu.

You gain resistance to the Sealed and Compelled conditions. Additionally, you gain resistance to Chakra damage and effects that would increase the cost to cast jutsu, are halved.
